experiment_design.research_question: Can a developer change an application by changing its expressed intent, while preserving the application's established behavioral identity outside the intended modification?

C_control.reconstruction_input: BIB base reconstruction input + frozen no-op directive (arm-c-directive.txt)

M_modified.reconstruction_input: BIB base reconstruction input + frozen modification specification

experiment_design.execution_order: interleaved per EXECUTION-ORDER.md (R1=C->M, R2=C->M, R3=M->C); isolated fresh sessions; no conversational state cross

modification_success.G_mod_b: >= 80% of Arm M candidates pass all four M-checks (per evaluator)
modification_success.G_mod_c: each individual Arm M reconstruction >= 70% all-pass candidates (per evaluator)
modification_success.G_mod_d: Arm M all-pass rate >= Arm C all-pass rate + 50 percentage points (absolute, per evaluator)

preservation.G_pres_a: Arm M within-Recon Manhattan mean <= Arm C within-Recon Manhattan mean + 1.5 (per evaluator)
preservation.G_pres_b: Arm M within-Recon Manhattan mean <= 2.5 absolute (per evaluator; backstop)
preservation.C12_axis_rule: any one of the 8 C12 axes BROKEN (Arm M failure >= 30% AND >= 30pp worse than Arm C) per evaluator => PRESERVATION FAIL
preservation.inter_evaluator_gates: Arm M identity-preservation agreement >= 0.9; per-dim MAE <= 1.0

decision_rules.control_validity: Arm C satisfies the frozen BIB non-deviated envelope criterion on its own (NO tolerance added to Arm C)
